content: Yuhuda kawo Iyo7aatame, Akaazenne Hizqiyaasa wode Moreshete as gidida Mikiyaasakko Samaariya gishshassinne Yerusalaame gishshas yida Xoossa qaalay hayssa,
Samaariya Bollanne Yerusalaame Bolla Yida Pirda

Hessi wuri hananay Yaaqoobey ooththida mooro gishshassinne Isra7eele nayta nagara gishshassa; Isra7eele asay iita ooththanaas gaaso gididay oonee? Izis waanna katamayo Samaariya gidekkee? Yuhuda asay eeqa goynnidi nagara ooththana mala gaththiday oonee? Yerusalaame gidekkee?
Hessa gishshas tani Samaariya keeth laallettidasonne woyne miththi tokettizaso kessana; iza keexettida yochcha shuchcha ta duge shoobban olananne izi xapho shodda dhayssana.

Izi eeqati wurikka meqerettana; izi eeqa keeththan diza laymatizaytas imettidaazi wuri taman xuugettana; izi misletakka ubbaa ta dhayssana; iza baas imettidayssa layman shiishshida mala ha7ikka izis dizaazi layman ekkizaaz gidana.
Hessa geedon tani yeekkays, wuu! Wuy gays; ta caammay baynda mela tohoninne mela kallo bays; worakana mala waassays; gutto mala waassays.
Izi madunththay paxonttaaz gidana; izippe aadhdhi Yuhudassara gidana; ta derey geliza penge Yerusalaame gakkides.
Geete deren haasayopite; yeeho mulekka yeekkofte; Beeti-Li7ofaaran gudulla bolla genderettite.
Intteno Shafiren dizaytoo may7oy baynda kallo Yeellatishe aadhdhite; Xa7inan dizayti heeppe kezettenna; Beeti-Ezeeley ceece bolla dawus; intteska gakki shempanaaso gidanaas dandayukku.
Metoppe shempanaas koshshan Maroten dizayti meton waayetteettes; hessika Yerusalaame penge gakkanaas iita metoy Xoossa achchafe yida gishshassa.
Intteno Laakishen dizaytoo parata gaarera gaththi oyseththite. Xiyoone macca naytas koyro nagaray inttenakko. Isra7eeles qohoy intte achchafe beettides.
Hessa gishshas intte Moreshet-Gates imota immana; Akiziibe katamay Isra7eele kawota baleththiza katama gidana.
Inttenoo Mareeshan dizaytoo! Ta inttena xoonizaade intte bolla ehana; Isra7eeles bonchcho gididaazi Adulaame ha yaana.
Intte isttan ufayettiza intte nayti inttefe di7etti baana gishshas intte hu7e bulusite.
